name: chat-cleanup
description: Global Codex commands for checking, previewing, refreshing, and continuing a clean project handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Global commands for a clean Codex handoff.
interface.longDescription: ChatCleanup is a small global plugin with guided, check, preview, status, refresh, and now commands. It preserves content outside the managed AGENTS.md block, keeps project boundaries explicit, and optionally opens a local desktop command window for copy-and-paste guidance.
